correctness.rationale: In H_m of dimension m the weighted incidence covariance S=a L_spoke+b L_rim with m(a+b)=1 has eigenvalues (m+1)a and a+4b sin^2(pi k/m). Strict concavity of logdet S in the affine orbit mass and a Poisson root-of-unity summation establish unique stationarity t_m in [1,2), with t_3=1 and F_m(2)=-m/[3(2^m-1)]. Dihedral symmetry and stationarity force effective resistance equal on spoke/rim orbits; the weighted resistance trace identity then gives R_e=m, placing all ±edge roots on the boundary Q=mS. For an arbitrary nonsymmetric off-center competing ellipsoid, averaging contact inequalities and AGM show det Q>=m^m det S with equality only at center zero and Q=mS. Fourier eigendeterminant gives semiaxes and volume. Uniform convergence f_m->f, f(2)=0 and independent exact symbolic differentiation f'(2)=-1/54 combine with F_m(2)/m=-1/[3(2^m-1)] to give limit 18. Independent bisection of stationarity for m=3,4,5,8,12,20 produced t_3=1, t_4≈1.3660254, t_5≈1.618034, t_20≈1.999982835 with scaled gaps trending to 18. Finite checks corroborate proof.
